7945443901500.title: NUBUK SPRAY
7945443901500.description:
Our premium Nubuck Spray is formulated to shield your nubuck shoes, jackets, bags, and other leather goods from dirt, moisture, and stains leaving them fresh. 

The spray coats these premium items with an invisible long-lasting protective layer, keeping the original leather texture intact and ensuring breathability. 

Moreover, Its water-repellent feature helps prevent moisture damage, stains, and soaking. 

Simple 4-Step Process To Use:

1. Shake the can well before use.
2. Hold the can about 6 inches away from the nubuck surface.
3. Spray evenly in light coats.
4. Allow to dry completely before use.

Caution: Always do a patch test, avoid contact with eyes/skin, and keep out of children’s reach.
